name: music_named_lines
description: Listening test: named lines via Music Drawer — layers play simultaneously
script: announce NAMED LINE TESTS — watch Ctrl+M drawer
announce 1/8: Single named line — drums: c4(3,8)
announce 2/8: Two lines — drums + bass (both should play)
strudel edit drums: "c4(3,8)".pianoroll() | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~".pianoroll() cps=0.8
announce 3/8: Three lines — drums + bass + melody (all simultaneous)
strudel edit drums: "c4(3,8)".pianoroll() | bass: "c2 ~ e2 ~".pianoroll() | melody: "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce 4/8: Different voices — flute melody + string chords + bass
strudel edit melody: "[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2" s=flute | chords: "[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4]" s=strings | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~" s=bass cps=0.4
# === 5. Swap one line (melody changes, bass stays) ===
strudel edit melody: "[c5 b4 g4 e4]*2" s=flute | chords: "[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4]" s=strings | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~" s=bass cps=0.4
announce 6/8: Drop middle layer — melody + bass only
strudel edit melody: "[c5 b4 g4 e4]*2" s=flute | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~" s=bass cps=0.5
announce 7/8: Three euclidean layers at different rates
strudel edit low: "c3(3,8)".pianoroll() | mid: "e4(5,8)".pianoroll() | hi: "g4(7,16)".pianoroll() cps=0.7
strudel edit chords: "[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] [g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3]".pianoroll() | melody: "[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2".pianoroll() | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ g2 ~".pianoroll() | perc: "c5(3,8)".pianoroll() cps=0.35
notify {SCRIPT} "Did all lines play simultaneously?" ["All good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
